uutiset.t: Report: CIA tortured more people with waterboarding than US agency admitted
uutiset.s: A New York Times report lends credence to long-held belief that torture method was more widely used than acknowledged.

uutiset.t: Egypt detains driver over Cairo fuel tanker fire that killed 31
uutiset.s: Prosecutors order drug tests for the 21-year-old suspect, who says he was overtaking when the crash happened.

uutiset.t: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police over low wages
uutiset.s: Bangladeshi garment workers clashed with police after a 36% minimum wage increase fell short of their demands.

uutiset.t: Attack on Saudi’s Jazan refinery kills one person, disrupts operations
uutiset.s: The attack killed a Nepali national, injured several people and sparked a fire, Saudi Energy Ministry says.

uutiset.t: Indian politician facing murder charges hosts 400,000-guest wedding
uutiset.s: An estimated 400,000 people attended politician Anant Singh’s daughter’s lavish wedding in Bihar, India’s poorest state.

uutiset.t: Mexico seeks US talks about suspected SpaceX debris
uutiset.s: Mexico concerned as SpaceX ramps up rocket launches from Starbase near border in Texas.

uutiset.t: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child
uutiset.s: US children would receive one share from SpaceX and one from him personally, Musk said.

uutiset.t: Peru burns more than 10 tonnes of seized drugs
uutiset.s: Peru began burning 10.7 tonnes of seized narcotics in its seventh and final drug disposal operation of 2026

uutiset.t: Why are winter rains forcing Palestinians in Gaza to flee again?
uutiset.s: Israeli restrictions on humanitarian aid, damaged buildings and flooded tents leave displaced Palestinians vulnerable.

uutiset.t: Judge strikes down Trump’s latest restrictions on US birthright citizenship
uutiset.s: After a Supreme Court ruling against it, the Trump administration had tried a narrower set of restrictions.

uutiset.t: Psychiatric care under scrutiny after abuse scandals in Croatia and Bosnia
uutiset.s: Persistent failures in psychiatric care have been exposed, including staff shortages, poor training and weak oversight.

uutiset.t: What will Trump’s latest tariffs mean for the world?
uutiset.s: New measures come after previous trade tariffs ruled illegal.

uutiset.t: Kushner explains the ‘good thing’ about Gaza’s destruction
uutiset.s: Jared Kushner says the “good thing” about Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza is that it can be built into “something new”.

uutiset.t: Trump calls GDP data released before midterms ‘fake’, demands investigation
uutiset.s: President says it was a deliberate decision to release 'fake' growth numbers before US midterm elections.

uutiset.t: Guinea-Bissau military leaders delay presidential election until 2028
uutiset.s: Military leaders say presidential and legislative poll scheduled for December 6 will now take place in November 2028.
